title: Implement two-peer tip reconciliation (CRDT merge)
description:
Implement reconcile(local_tips: &[Cid], remote_tips: &[Cid], storage: &dyn LogStorage) -> ReconcileResult. ReconcileResult identifies: entries remote has that local lacks (to fetch), entries local has that remote lacks (to send). Uses tip-set union semantics. Artifact: src/group_log/reconcile.rs.

Acceptance:
- reconcile() on two identical tip sets returns empty want/have sets
- reconcile() after a partition correctly identifies diverged entries in both directions
- reconcile() is commutative: A.reconcile(B) and B.reconcile(A) produce symmetric results
- Unit test: three-node scenario where two nodes diverge and then merge
